title: Section 18: Reprisal for reporting violations of law or for tenant's union activity; damages and costs; notice of termination, presumption
requirement: Landlords are prohibited from threatening or taking reprisals against residential tenants for reporting code violations, joining a tenants' union, or pursuing legal rights. Receipt of a notice of termination, rent increase, or substantial alteration in tenancy terms within six months of such tenant activity creates a rebuttable presumption of reprisal.
quoted_span: Any person or agent thereof who threatens to or takes reprisals against any tenant of residential premises for the tenant's act of, commencing, proceeding with, or obtaining relief in any judicial or administrative action the purpose of which action is to obtain damages under, or otherwise enforce, any federal, state or local law

title: Section 18: Waiver in leases or other rental agreements prohibited
requirement: Any waiver of the statutory protections against landlord reprisals contained in any lease or other rental agreement shall be void and unenforceable.
quoted_span: Any waiver of this provision in any lease or other rental agreement shall be void and unenforceable.
